action: Opens on finished Midoriya bust: big eyes with dark outline, freckles, wide open mouth, spiky locks, goggles, collar and tie.

Starts from a smooth sphere, pushes in the eye/brow area and pulls a jaw down; picks brushes from a popup palette where ClayBu is highlighted (Move, ClayBu, ClayTu, Inflat, SnakeH, TrimRe, ZReme, ZModel, TrimCu, SliceCu, Rake, Smooth visible).
why: Rough the head shape (skull, face front, jaw) from a sphere.
reader_equivalent: UV sphere + Voxel Remesh, Grab for jaw, Clay Strips for brow.

action: Masks areas (dark mask spots on eye socket and cheek/jaw), sculpts large round eye sockets and adds an ear.
why: Protect neighbouring forms while carving big anime eye sockets and shaping the jaw.
reader_equivalent: Mask brush (Ctrl to invert), then Clay Strips/Grab; ear from Clay Strips or a separate mesh joined by remesh.

action: Uses the Gizmo on masked regions to move the cheek/jaw and adjust features; face now has big round eye sockets with eyeballs and irises, a large open mouth cavity, small nose, and freckles as small dimples.
why: Reposition whole features quickly instead of re-sculpting them.
reader_equivalent: Mask then G/R/S in Sculpt Mode (Transform tools) or Pose brush.

action: Draws thick dark outline rings around each eye and dark brow arcs, refines the iris with a highlight bump inside a recessed pupil (brush size readout 48.5 visible).
tool: fine brush on pen display; dark lines look like polypaint or incised grooves (not determinable)
why: Anime eye read from a bold outline around a recessed eye with a sculpted highlight.
reader_equivalent: Crease/Draw Sharp for groove outline or Texture Paint for dark lines; Inflate small dot for the highlight.

action: Adds hair as separate low-poly faceted locks: front bangs first over the bald head, then the large outer spikes all round; collar is also low-poly faceted.
tool: separate lock geometry (flat-shaded low poly, likely ZModeler); DynaMesh Resolucion 3144 on the head
why: Block hair silhouette lock by lock while the head stays smooth.
reader_equivalent: Low-poly lock meshes built in Edit Mode (extrude/scale to a point) with flat shading, later subdivided.

action: Hair locks smoothed and layered, goggles added on the forehead band, then shirt, vest and striped tie on the bust.
why: Accessories after hair silhouette is set.
reader_equivalent: Separate meshes for goggles (modelled) and tie; Solidify/Shrinkwrap for straps.
